meta.note: Inventory (component families, statuses, sizes) taken from the code; values are the redesigned ink + mint identity that replaces the indigo palette.

tokens.name: bg-app
tokens.usage: Main content area behind every screen. Replaces bg-app / bg-panel / bg-surface.

tokens.name: bg-sidebar
tokens.usage: Left sidebar, segmented-control track, code and preview wells.

tokens.name: bg-deep
tokens.usage: Deepest well: run log tail, raw event log, graph canvas ground.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised objects: composer, inputs, menus, dialogs, toasts, graph nodes.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on rows and nav items; the selected nav item. Replaces bg-white/[.06].

tokens.name: surface-active
tokens.usage: The 'on' segment of a segmented control, pressed ghost buttons.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and sections. Decorative only, not a control boundary.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Card and panel outlines.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, outline buttons and chips. Below 3:1 on bg-app by design; the focus ring carries focus.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on bg-app, bg-sidebar and surface.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Nav labels and list titles on bg-sidebar and surface.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Secondary values: paths, addresses, settings values, on any surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Descriptions, metadata, timestamps, section labels. Holds 4.5:1 on bg-app, bg-sidebar and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled text, interrupted / thinking glyphs only. Fails 4.5:1: never for copy someone must read.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: THE accent. Primary button fill, send button, logo, selected graph node ring, active chip fill. Text on it is on-mint.

tokens.name: mint-text
tokens.usage: Links and accent-coloured text on bg-app and surface.

tokens.name: mint-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of links; hover fill is mint-strong.

tokens.name: mint-strong
tokens.usage: Hover fill of primary buttons.

tokens.name: mint-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fills: diff additions, success badges, selected template chip ground.

tokens.name: on-mint
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a mint fill. Never white.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid, 2px offset in the ground colour. Meets 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: workflow
tokens.usage: Workflow (slash-command) kind: graph node fill, list icon, kind badge text. Replaces command indigo.

tokens.name: workflow-soft
tokens.usage: Workflow badge and icon-tile ground.

tokens.name: agent
tokens.usage: Agent (subagent) kind: graph node fill, list icon, kind badge text. Differs from workflow in lightness, not only hue.

tokens.name: agent-soft
tokens.usage: Agent badge and icon-tile ground.

tokens.name: skill
tokens.usage: Skill kind in the graph legend and badges.

tokens.name: skill-soft
tokens.usage: Skill badge ground.

tokens.name: running
tokens.usage: Live run state: starting / running glyphs, running node ring, animated edges. Replaces run-active.

tokens.name: running-soft
tokens.usage: Running badge ground and node glow.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and glyphs: done, ok, published, created, connected.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success badge and banner ground.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Draft, lossy export, needs attention. Orange so it never reads as the workflow amber.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning badge and banner ground.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error glyphs, conflict markers, broken edges, destructive button fill (text on it: on-danger).

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Error and conflict copy on danger-soft and bg-app.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Conflict banners, error toasts, daemon-disconnected ribbon.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill.

tokens.name: diff-add
tokens.usage: Added lines in the publish diff.

tokens.name: diff-del
tokens.usage: Removed lines in the publish diff.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs and the builder drawer.

tokens.name: graph-dot
tokens.usage: Dot-grid pattern on the graph canvas.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per screen: Project name, Templates, Settings.

styles.name: dialog-title
styles.usage: Dialog and drawer titles, empty-state headline.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section headings inside a screen, card titles in dialogs.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Publishing renders to a temp folder and shows the diff.
styles.usage: Composer input, descriptions under titles, long prose.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Default UI size: nav items, rows, inputs, buttons, menu items. Replaces text-sm and text-[13px]/[13.5px].

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Small buttons, chips, tabs, form labels. Replaces text-[12.5px]/[13px].

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata, timestamps, helper text, tooltips. Replaces text-[11px]/[11.5px]/[12px].

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase sidebar group labels and badge text. Replaces text-[9.5px]/[10px]/[10.5px].

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Editors, diff, previews, file paths, /command names.

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: Run log tail, transcript rows, token counts, graph node subtitles.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside chips and badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a row; icon-to-label in buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Nav item and row horizontal padding; gap inside a card's header.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between cards; graph dot pitch.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Dialog body padding; settings row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between screen sections; dialog header padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between major blocks on Home.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Screen padding (top and sides) of the main area.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Bottom padding of a screen; empty-state vertical rhythm.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Kind icon tiles, inline code, checkbox.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, menu items, segmented-control thumb.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav items, list rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, graph nodes, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Composer, dialogs, drawer inner edge.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges, filter chips, status pills, avatar.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Row menus, popovers, tooltips, command palette.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the builder drawer.

tokens.name: shadow-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts and the run bar.

tokens.name: shadow-composer
tokens.usage: The home composer only.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, segmented thumbs, chips.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons, inputs, selects, nav items.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Large buttons (dialog primary), search fields.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Expanded sidebar; collapses to 56px icon rail.

tokens.name: drawer-width
tokens.usage: Builder drawer; live preview pane adds 440px on wide screens.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of Settings and Home content columns.

tokens.name: content-wide
tokens.usage: Max width of Project and Templates grids.

tokens.name: z-rail
tokens.usage: Sidebar.

tokens.name: z-runbar
tokens.usage: Run bar dock.

tokens.name: z-drawer
tokens.usage: Builder drawer and its scrim.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and their scrim.

tokens.name: z-menu
tokens.usage: Menus and tooltips (above dialogs).

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts.
